summary: Iteration 3 (WOW-FACTOR 'Living Synapse' redesign) tested end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 new pytest cases pass covering (a) chain endpoint returns rank/total_in_chain/percentile plus me.spark_number=1 for initiator, (b) POST /tartans/{token}/join response.member.spark_number is an int > 1 for new joiners and lineage attributes to inviter (Amina), (c) POST /tartans creates initiator with spark_number=1 / rank=1 / total_in_chain=1, (d) percentile bounded 1..100. Full regression suite still green: 24/24 total (test_tartan_api 13 + test_iteration2 7 + test_iteration3 4). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Home renders immersive LivingChainCanvas hero + ignite-spark-hero-cta + start-tartan-button + 22 unique chain-card SVG sigils. /j/j4atawQ7lw join flow: clicking join-chain-cta-button -> filling nickname-input -> confirm-join-button -> the JoinReveal overlay (data-testid join-reveal) appears with 'YOU JOINED THE CHAIN', big Spark #68, chain sigil, 'NODE ACTIVATED · <city>' pill, and share launchpad (reveal-whatsapp-button, reveal-copy-button, reveal-continue-button). Clicking reveal-continue-button navigates to /me/{new share} (verified ee5ZZM3mAc). MeDashboard shows spark-status with 'YOUR SPARK #68', spreader-rank '#25', 'Top 65% of 68', and PersonalRipple SVG viz (data-testid personal-ripple). Initiator /me/j4atawQ7lw shows rank '#1', 'Top 100% of 68', organizer-dashboard-link present, and personal-ripple renders. Create-a-Tartan flow: start-tartan-button opens dialog with live sigil SVG preview (inside data-testid start-tartan-modal) as title is typed; create-tartan-submit triggers the join-reveal overlay showing 'YOU LIT THE SPARK' + Spark #1, and reveal-continue-button navigates to /me/{share} of the new initiator.

issues: Visual stacking overlap: the big Spark #N number, the chain sigil, and the 3-stat card (verified/activated/cities) partially overlap at narrow widths — the NODE ACTIVATED pill also sits on top of the stats card. Reveal reads correctly but layout looks crowded/z-fighting on mobile.
Confetti particles overlay slightly obscures the sigil during the staged animation (cosmetic).
Radix warning persists: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — non-blocking a11y warning inherited from iterations 1/2.
When joining without a city selected, the pill shows 'NODE ACTIVATED · Remote'. Consider auto-detecting or hiding the pill instead of showing 'Remote' if that's a fallback.

action_items: (Optional) Tighten JoinReveal mobile layout so Spark#N, sigil, NODE-ACTIVATED pill and stats card do not overlap at 390px width.
(Optional) Suppress or replace 'NODE ACTIVATED · Remote' when the joiner has not provided a city (either hide pill or use inferred city).
(Optional, carried over) Add DialogTitle/Description or VisuallyHidden wrapper to StartTartanDialog / MilestoneCard for Radix a11y compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: backfill_sparks() runs on every startup and scans all tartans; for large deployments consider a one-shot migration flag stored in a system collection instead of per-boot scan.

Rank computation in chain endpoint counts descendants ahead per-request via count_documents; at scale precompute rank/percentile on write (or cache in Redis) to avoid O(N) DB scans on hot dashboard route.
LivingChainCanvas triggers a Canvas2D getImageData warning ('willReadFrequently=true' hint). Minor perf tweak — set the flag to avoid GPU->CPU readback overhead on low-end mobile.
JoinReveal is time-staged with fixed setTimeouts (~0.3/1.3/2.1/2.9s) — a user who navigates away quickly may miss the share launchpad; consider allowing skip/tap-to-advance.
Deterministic aura/sigil seeding (hashSeed) uses chain token — collisions extremely unlikely but ensure user-created tokens are validated to avoid empty/very-short seeds producing dim palettes.
